messages.Finds up to 20 dated stories from the la: Finds up to 20 dated stories from the last 7 days in a niche with web search, with links and post angles. Use for "what's trending", "this week's news in…", "research my niche".
messages.Designs the image for a post: a structur: Designs the image for a post: a structured HTML graphic rendered to PNG or an AI infographic (whiteboard or branded). Use for "design a graphic for my post", "make an image for this post".
messages.Builds a branded multi-slide carousel (1: Builds a branded multi-slide carousel (1080x1350): brief, approval, then one image prompt or render per slide. Use for "carousel", "turn this into slides".
messages.Turns a post, newsletter or note into a: Turns a post, newsletter or note into a hand-drawn whiteboard infographic (brief + image prompt or generated image). Use for "whiteboard infographic", "hand-drawn graphic".
messages.Writes short original quotes and a match: Writes short original quotes and a matching quote graphic for a caption. Use for "quote post", "quote graphic", "motivational post".
messages.Writes a deadpan pinned/first comment fo: Writes a deadpan pinned/first comment for a post together with a matching image prompt. Use for "pinned comment", "first comment".
messages.Rewrites a LinkedIn profile: headline op: Rewrites a LinkedIn profile: headline options, about, experience, featured section and banner/photo image prompts. Use for "optimize my profile", "rewrite my headline".
messages.Turns a video title into a high-click br: Turns a video title into a high-click branded YouTube thumbnail prompt or image. Use for "thumbnail", "YouTube cover".
messages.Writes a Reel/short video script in your: Writes a Reel/short video script in your voice from a reference video's transcript and your content. Use for "script a reel", "turn this into a reel".
messages.Turns a LinkedIn Analytics export (CSV): Turns a LinkedIn Analytics export (CSV) into an interactive visual report and 5 data-backed recommendations. Use for "analyse my LinkedIn", "build my dashboard".
